name: RateManagement
caption: Balans / Sistem servisi / Yeni Valyuta məzənnələri

datasets.name: RatesDataSet
datasets.sql:
select
  tr.VAL_KOD as CurrencyID,
  tr.OSTAT,
  tr.buy_rate,
  tr.sell_rate,Currency.val_name,
  Currency.VALU_NAME as Name,
  tr.dat,tr.sell_rate_cashless,tr.buy_rate_cashless,
  tr.rowid
from
  temprate tr,
  AVALUTE Currency
where
  Currency.VALUTE = tr.VAL_KOD
order by Currency.Valute

datasets.name: OracleDataSet3
datasets.sql:
SELECT a.id, a.op_id, a.no_prov, a.dat, a.debt, a.kredit, a.val_acc,
       a.vid_op, a.ammount, a.lammount, a.tim, a.shifr, a.no_pack,
       a.kassa_b, a.kassa_z, a.no_filial, a.sloj_prov, a.bank_d,
       a.bank_k, a.no_doc, a.no_mem, a.d1, a.k1, a.rate_d, a.rate_c,
       a.parentid, a.currencyid_c, a.ammount_c, a.name, a.commit_opid,
       a.countrid, a.reportid, a.committime, a.userinsert, a.usercommit,
       a.bdg_code, a.procname
  FROM temprepairerrors a

datasets.name: OracleDataSet5
datasets.sql:
select
  SID,
  Serial#,
  AudSID,
  user#,
  UserName,
  Status,
  OSUser,
  Process,
  Machine,
  Terminal,
  Program,
  Logon_Time,
  decode(UserEnv('SESSIONID'), AudSID, 1, 0) as IsCurrentUser
from sys.v_$session
where
  (Type = 'USER')
  and (UserName is not null)
  and (Program = (
    select program 
      from sys.v_$session 
    where AudSID = UserEnv('SESSIONID')
    )
  )
  and (Status <> 'KILLED')
